PT442.source: Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae, Pyramid Text 442, Pepi I
PT442.note: PT 442 places the fallen/overthrown Osirian state in Nedit and, in the same composition, the coming of Osiris as Orion with conception by the sky and birth by the Duat.
